items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with it as long as I could - as long as I could and when we got to Grand Island, Nebraska - I said, good-bye Al Sky

ctx.x: Was I? That long? Well, I worked all over that place-- all over that State. I once went out
with a guy named Al Sky [Al Skoin] and His Musical Stars and I toured---
That was what they used to call the -- territory band - wasn't it?
